test_title: PYST 12: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: CZMB is related to NNAM in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, LKQD is related to WRLO. To which of the following is HNTF related. following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• (11) is added to the first and fourth letter's position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• (1) is subtracted from the second and third letter's position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• CZMB is written as NNAM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad5eda8e5f024442b45314fc3c1bf0a844a7d30286bce89913e1838689cd7d62.png] 

And,

 
• LKQD is written as WRLO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6364fd7ce5a5df3e79e963540d8e93b180ac7468a536fcf988585ef42779cc21.png] 

Similarly,

 
• HNTF is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce4e87e629322e7913c892718c08a38b15cc51aa65d620c1bfa27d312801328f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**SUOQ**".
